ideas.title: Uncovering the $11M Minnesota Medicaid Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: Investigate the $11M Medicaid fraud case and identify all parties involved
ideas.angle: Follow the money and identify patterns in the fraud scheme
questions: Who is behind the fraud scheme?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and bring those responsible to justice. Further investigation is needed to identify all parties involved and understand the scope of the scheme.
